name: Rhinoceros (African Monsters (PF1))
body:
MYTHIC RHINOCEROS
CR 5/MR 2

This rhinoceros has a low-slung head with twisted ears that lie back along its neck.

XP 1,600
N Large animal
Init +0; Senses scent; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 9, flat-footed 18 (+9 natural, –1 size)
hp 58 (5d8+36)
Fort +10, Ref +4, Will +2
Defensive Abilities fortification (50%)MA; DR 5/epic

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee gore +9 (2d6+10)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks awesome charge, mythic power (2/day, surge ++1d6), powerful charge (gore, 4d6+15)

STATISTICS

Str 24, Dex 10, Con 19, Int 2, Wis 13, Cha 5
Base Atk +3; CMB +11; CMD 21 (25 vs. trip)
Feats Endurance, Great Fortitude, Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Perception +12
SQ armored warbeastma

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Armored Warbeast (Ex)

A mythic rhinoceros is proficient with light, medium, and heavy armor, and its movement is not slowed when wearing medium or heavy armor.

Awesome Charge (Ex)

When a mythic rhinoceros hits a Medium or smaller creature with its charge attack, it can attempt an awesome blow combat maneuver against the target as a swift action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. If the mythic rhinoceros expends one use of its mythic power, it can use this ability against a target of any size and may add its mythic surge +die as a bonus on the combat maneuver check.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm plains
Organization solitary, pair, or herd (3–12)
Treasure none
